scientific_integrity: Continuum Robin spectral quantization and tridiagonal expansions are proved analytically. The exact critical norm has a positive-ground-state identity. Finite verification is supplemental, not evidence of an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed rank and compact real-parameter intervals; no uniformity in ranks growing with dimension. Literature priority is subject to possible unindexed local-to-unity matrix literature.
title: First-order critical-window singular spectra of nilpotent-shift resolvents
